title: Ensure inactive branches are periodically reviewed and removed
description: Abandoned branches hold unreviewed code and stale dependencies while still being reachable and mergeable. They also hide genuinely active work in a long branch list. Age is the committer date of each branch's tip, which a client sets: an estimate of activity, not proof of it.
remediation: Repos -> Branches: review the listed branches and delete the finished or abandoned ones (More options -> Delete branch), or run `git push origin --delete <branch>`. To keep this from recurring, tick "Delete <branch> after merging" when completing pull requests. Adjust the window with thresholds.staleBranchDays, and how many may remain with thresholds.maxStaleBranches, in azure-devops-bench's config.
fixSummary: Delete finished branches at Repos -> Branches -> (branch) -> Delete branch.
